Rewrite mode, since all the facts are present. I merged the two pricing paragraphs and cut "to give you more options during the week", which added nothing (and Sunday isn't midweek). I also replaced the "community" line with a plainer thank-you.

Subject: Membership pricing update + Sunday evening classes

Hi everyone,

On December 1, the unlimited monthly membership goes from $119 to $135. As a current member, you keep the $119 rate until March 1, when the $135 rate starts for you.

We're also adding Sunday evening classes and will share the times soon.

Thanks for being a member. If you have questions about the price change, just reply to this email.
